description.title: Description: AI suggestion
description.detail: The current description has {length} characters (Google accepts up to 750). Compare the current one with the suggestion; nothing changes on the profile without your approval.

descriptionPolicy.title: The description has {problem, select, link {a link} contact {contact details} promotion {a promotion} other {forbidden content}}
descriptionPolicy.detail: Google does not accept links, contact details or promotions in the description. Action: replace it with the suggested version, without that content.

nameKeywords.title: The profile name has a keyword, city or slogan
nameKeywords.detail: Google's guidelines ask for the real business name; a name with keywords may get the profile suspended. Action: use the real name (suggestion next to it, when there is one).

categories.title: Categories: AI suggestion
categories.detail: The profile has {count, plural, =0 {no additional category} one {# additional category} other {# additional categories}} today. The primary category weighs the most in local search; check the suggestion.

reply.title: Draft reply to the {rating, plural, one {# star} other {# star}} review
reply.detail: {origin, select, ai {Written by the AI, with no sensitive data, no employee name and no argument.} other {Safe reply of the star band: the AI suggestion did not pass the privacy rules or did not come.}} Review it before publishing.

keywordsChosen.title: Map keywords: {keywords}
keywordsChosen.detail: The agent picked {count, plural, one {# keyword} other {# keywords}} from the profile category. Adjust them whenever you like.

keywordsKept.title: Map keywords: {keywords}
keywordsKept.detail: We kept the {count, plural, one {# monitored keyword} other {# monitored keywords}} of this unit.

keywordsNone.title: No keyword to measure the map
keywordsNone.detail: The profile has no primary category. Action: confirm the profile category or add the keywords by hand.

score.title: Maps health: {score} out of 100
score.detail: Math: visibility {visibility} of 35 + reviews {reviews} of 25 + pace and replies {activity} of 20 + complete profile {profile} of 20. {weakest, select, visibility {Action: use the names of the neighbourhoods around you in the description, posts and replies.} reviews {Action: ask every customer served for a review, with the same request for everyone.} activity {Action: reply to the pending reviews and keep a steady pace of requests.} profile {Action: complete the profile (description, categories, hours and photos).} other {}}

notFound.title: The profile does not show on the map for “{keyword}”
notFound.detail: None of the {total} grid points shows the profile in the top 20. Action: check that the primary category matches “{keyword}” and use the term in the description and posts (never in the name).

solvWeak.title: Top 3 in {solv}% of the map for “{keyword}”
solvWeak.detail: In the top 3 at {top3} of {total} points; shows at {found}, average position {averageRank}. {direction, select, n {The weakest area is the north.} ne {The weakest area is the northeast.} e {The weakest area is the east.} se {The weakest area is the southeast.} s {The weakest area is the south.} sw {The weakest area is the southwest.} w {The weakest area is the west.} nw {The weakest area is the northwest.} other {}} {vocabulary, select, yes {Action: use the neighbourhoods where competitors rank ahead ({neighborhoods}) in the description, posts and replies.} other {Action: use the names of the neighbourhoods around you in the description, posts and replies.}} Distance weighs, and no content fixes being far.

solvModerate.title: Top 3 in {solv}% of the map for “{keyword}”
solvModerate.detail: In the top 3 at {top3} of {total} points; shows at {found}, average position {averageRank}. {direction, select, n {The weakest area is the north.} ne {The weakest area is the northeast.} e {The weakest area is the east.} se {The weakest area is the southeast.} s {The weakest area is the south.} sw {The weakest area is the southwest.} w {The weakest area is the west.} nw {The weakest area is the northwest.} other {}} {vocabulary, select, yes {Action: reinforce the neighbourhoods {neighborhoods} in the description, posts and replies.} other {Action: reinforce the names of the neighbourhoods around you in the profile content.}}

solvStrong.title: Top 3 in {solv}% of the map for “{keyword}”
solvStrong.detail: Strong presence: top 3 at {top3} of {total} points, average position {averageRank}. Action: keep the review pace and watch for new competitors.

baseline.title: Starting point recorded
baseline.detail: First map of the unit: top 3 in {solv}% of the points and score {score}. The next reports compare with it. It does not use the monthly quota.

progress.title: Since the starting point: top 3 from {baselineSolv}% to {solv}%

competitors.title: {count, plural, =0 {No competitor} one {# competitor} other {# competitors}} in the radius for “{keyword}”
competitors.detail: The strongest of the grid: {leader} (rating {leaderRating}, {leaderReviews, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}).

newCompetitor.title: New competitor in the radius: {name}
newCompetitor.detail: Entered the top 10 for “{keyword}” (average position {averageRank}, rating {rating}, {reviews, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}). Action: compare its rating and number of reviews with yours, keep asking every customer for a review and mark it as a reference competitor if it makes sense.

reviewsPace.title: Review pace: {monthly} per month
reviewsPace.detail: Last review {days} days ago. Good pace; keep asking every customer for a review.

reviewsPaceLow.title: Few new reviews: {monthly} per month
reviewsPaceLow.detail: Last review {days} days ago; the reference is {reference} per month. Action: ask every customer served for a review, always with the same request, during business hours.

reviewsGap.title: {days}-day gap without a review
reviewsGap.detail: Long gaps without new reviews tend to drop the position (market study, not a Google rule). Action: keep the review request steady, to every customer.

responseLow.title: {rate}% of the reviews replied
responseLow.detail: {pending, plural, one {# review is} other {# reviews are}} without a reply. Action: reply; the drafts are in the AI suggestions.

responseGood.title: {rate}% of the reviews replied
responseGood.detail: {pending, plural, =0 {No review pending.} one {# review pending.} other {# reviews pending.}} Keep replying to all of them.

ratingBelow.title: Rating {rating} below the competitors' median ({median})
ratingBelow.detail: Action: reply to the negative reviews and take each case to a private channel; ask every customer for a review, without filtering who was satisfied.

countBelow.title: {count} reviews; competitors have {median} (median)
countBelow.detail: Action: use the review request link and QR code with every customer served, during business hours.

reviewsBurst.title: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} with several 5-star reviews together
reviewsBurst.detail: Peaks of 5 stars on the same day may look artificial (market study signal, not a Google rule). Action: space the requests and make the same request to every customer.

mapsQuota.title: Map measurements of the month used up ({used} of {limit})
mapsQuota.detail: The next measurement comes next month or with a bigger plan. The starting point does not count.

mapsNoCoordinates.title: No location for the unit
mapsNoCoordinates.detail: The map is built around the unit. Action: check the address and coordinates of the unit and run the analysis again.

maps.title: Maps health
maps.description: Position on the map against competitors, with the math in view.
maps.empty: There is no map measurement for this unit yet.
maps.baselineCompare: Starting point on {date}: score {score}, top 3 in {solv}%

formulas.visibility: Mean visibility of {visibility}% (top 3 is worth 3, positions 4 to 10 are worth 1) over {keywords, plural, one {# keyword} other {# keywords}}, times 35.
formulas.reviews: Rating {rating} against {ratingReference} and {reviewCount} reviews against {countReference} ({reference, select, competitors {competitors' median} other {fixed reference}}).

maps.heatmapCaption: {size}×{size} grid, {radius} km radius. Each square is a search made from that point; the middle one is the unit.
maps.cell: Row {row}, column {column}: {rank, select, none {outside the top 20} other {position {rank}}}
maps.neighborhoods: Neighbourhoods to use in the content
maps.competitorsDescription: The strongest of the grid for “{keyword}”.
maps.cost: {calls, plural, one {# query} other {# queries}}, estimated cost US$ {cost}
maps.demoSubtitle: Component of the GMN agent with sample data. The automation page uses the same component.
